## Build a visNetwork of the data model from the docs and dictionaries {.unnumbered} ### Description A standalone (no Shiny) counterpart to erd_network() for static documents. Nodes are the tables in the ERD; edges are the documented join relationships (shared-key links) parsed from inst/data-model.md, dashed when name-guarded. Hovering a node shows that table's grain, key, description and every column definition, read from inst/dict/*.yml; hovering an edge shows the join key. Both the graph and the tooltips are generated from the files in inst/, so the diagram stays in sync with the data model. ### Usage 
data_model_network(
  model_path = erd_asset("data-model.md"),
  dict = app_dict(),
  height = "650px",
  width = "100%"
)
### Arguments
model_path Path to the data-model doc carrying the mermaid ERD. Defaults to the packaged inst/data-model.md (falls back to the checkout).
dict A named list of dictionary entries, as returned by app_dict(). Defaults to reading the packaged inst/dict/*.yml.
height, width visNetwork dimensions.
### Value A visNetwork htmlwidget. ### Examples ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library("cfb2nfl") data_model_network() ``` :::
